maddeler.e:
نصطلق (form VIII)
# نَصْطَلِقُ (naṣṭaliqu) /nasˤ.tˤa.li.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# نُصْطَلَقُ (nuṣṭalaqu) /nusˤ.tˤa.la.qu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# نَصْطَلِقَ (naṣṭaliqa) /nasˤ.tˤa.li.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# نُصْطَلَقَ (nuṣṭalaqa) /nusˤ.tˤa.
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
